findings.scenario: While a Create proposal fetch is in flight, changing the selected role or data class sets submission to idle, which re-enables the submit button. Further submits return immediately because submitting.current is still true (silent no-op). When the original request finishes it still setSubmission(result), so the receipt can belong to a teammate/data class other than the one now selected.
findings.remediation: Keep a monotonic request generation (or AbortController); ignore stale results; do not clear working on selection changes; disable roster, data-class, and submit until the in-flight call settles; if the user changes binding, abort or keep working visible.

findings.scenario: If runId changes while submitAiTeammateAssignment is in flight, roster reload is cancelled via the active flag but submission/submitting are not. The old run's proposal/receipt is written into the new run's panel, breaking run-scoping.
findings.remediation: Reset submission to idle on runId change, include runId in the request generation key, and drop results that do not match the current runId.

findings.scenario: Assignment, data class, and radios stay editable during working. The result UI never prints proposal.task, so the composer can show a different assignment than the receipt after an in-flight edit.
findings.remediation: Disable or read-lock composer controls while working and render the bound proposal.task (and teammate) on the receipt.

findings.scenario: Try again sets loading then awaits without a generation token. Overlapping retries or a retry racing the runId effect can apply an older roster error over a newer success (or the reverse).
findings.remediation: Reuse the same active/generation guard as the mount effect and ignore stale loadAiTeammates resolutions.

findings.scenario: Switching Teammates ↔ Site advice unmounts LocalAiTeammatePanel, wiping the bounded assignment, roster, and textual receipt without warning. The receipt is therefore not stably exposed inside Agent Studio.
findings.remediation: Hoist teammate state or keep both panes mounted and hide the inactive one with hidden/inert so Site advice stays separate without destroying the receipt.

findings.scenario: Roster loading uses role=status, but assignment working only flips the submit label to Creating…. Users not focused on that button get no accessible loading state.
findings.remediation: Set aria-busy on the form/section and a role=status live region (e.g. Creating a local proposal…) for the working state.

findings.scenario: Submission errors are a role=alert sibling; the textarea is not aria-invalid and aria-describedby stays only on the help text, so the error is not bound to the composer control.
findings.remediation: On submission.kind === error, set aria-invalid and point aria-describedby at both the help id and the error id.

findings.scenario: The textual receipt always labels a Provider cost row. That names a provider on the Local foundation surface even when the value is $0.
findings.remediation: Render a non-provider label (e.g. Cost: none) or omit the row unless asserting no external spend without the word provider.

findings.line: announces a terminal proposal receipt with every audit field in text
findings.scenario: The assertion for Proposal only — nothing is applied automatically matches the always-on banner, not proposal.notice. startedAt, stoppedAt, jobSha256, outputSchemaId, and partialOutputSha256 are never required. renderToStaticMarkup never runs useEffect, so a panel that never loads the eight-role roster still passes.
findings.remediation: Assert the API notice and omitted audit fields inside the receipt node; add a mounted/async test that fetch resolves to eight radios and that in-flight selection cannot re-enable a silent submit.

findings.line: rejects an unauthorized malformed body before attempting JSON parsing
findings.scenario: The test only checks 403 + error JSON. It would still pass if the handler parsed the body first and then authorized, so it does not lock the authenticate-before-body-parse rule.
findings.remediation: Spy request.json (or pass a throwing body stream) and assert it is not read on unauthorized POST.

audit.proof_assessment: The supplied proof is a command log plus static/source tests (renderToStaticMarkup, CSS/Workbench greps). It does not exercise auth-before-parse, in-flight state, mode-switch lifecycle, or runtime a11y. Full-suite green is explicitly not claimed; E2E still uses the old assistant label. Treat as incomplete evidence.
residual_risks: executeAiTeammateJobV1 and AiTeammateDataClassV1Schema live outside the slice; fail-closed data classes and in-memory-only execution are inferred from tests, not reviewed source.
Client accept path does not pin executionLane, providerCostUsd, effectClasses, or proposal.notice before rendering.
View mode still hides Agent Studio entirely, so the proposal-only roster is unreachable without Edit.
Existing E2E/axe viewport contracts were not updated in this allowlist.
